text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"'—Gather 'round! We will now announce 
a surprise event here on the outdoor 
stage!'"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"'A festival simply cannot end without the 
very essence of an Umamusume! 
All Umamusume fans, please rush over to 
the announcement stage!'"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Is that... Duramente-san on stage? 
I wonder if the surprise event has 
something to do with her."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Cheval-chi snagged a front-row seat! 
Heyyy... wait, huh? She's with Royce-san. 
That's rare."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"—I declare here and now that I am the 
strongest. 
At any time, against any opponent... 
Therefore—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I hereby declare the opening of an 
'Exhibition Race'—! 
Anyone confident they can defeat me... 
step forward!"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, we get to see a race?! 
Duramente-san is running?! Yaaay!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, something crazy just started?! 
But is there anyone who would actually 
challenge Duramente-san...?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Right here!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry, but I can't stay quiet when I hear 
the word 'strongest.' 
Because... 'The Strongest Umamusume' is a 
title that rightfully belongs to ME!"

text_block_list.name: Person Charmed by Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Challenging that Duramente?! 
So fiery...! That girl's on fire...!!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I know how capable you are... 
Even so! I will stand and face you! 
Because I refuse to give up on my dream!"

text_block_list.name: Person Hooked on Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Uooohhh! Don't you dare give up on your 
dream! 
I'll be right here backing you up—!!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"(Hehe, the dramatic storyline of bravely 
challenging her is set perfectly! 
But that's not all—I need real strength to 
back it up...! I will definitely win!)"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"(If I raise my hand here and lose, 
it'll be so embarrassing, so pathetic...)"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"(...Even so, this is how I always feel... 
I want to run... I want to run and 
win...)"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"(I want to prove to everyone that I'm a 
great Umamusume... 
And there are people who cheer on someone 
like me... So...!!)"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'll... I'll run too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm not just going to show my usual 
self... 
I'll show them that I can win... that I'm 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaahhhh! 
Turbo's gonna run too! Turbo's entering!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Me too...! This time for sure, I want to 
beat you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's way too hyped up!? ...Well, it 
is New Year's Eve, right? 
It's a festival, right? A year-end finale 
run might not be so bad after all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, Cheval-chi, way to go! 
Right, Big Sis?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great, let's do this! 
I'm confident!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Go, go, do your absolute best! You can 
totally win this! 
I'm rooting for you with all I've got! 
You're the coolest~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!? Wh-What a huge crowd...!?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's eyes are sparkling... 
And... they look like they're having so 
much fun.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan
text_block_list.text:
D-Duramente-san! Please show us your 
overwhelming strength again! 
Because I truly believe my favorite is the 
strongest in the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Cheval's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-kun! That was so thrilling earlier! 
You looked so cool! 
I'll cheer for you a whole bunch again!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Y-Yeah...! I'll... win...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like we can properly live up 
to the love each of us receives! 
Just as analyzed, precisely as planned!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's Eve exhibition race, hastily 
organized on short notice!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here at Tracen Academy, packed with 
countless fans, 
the final showdown of the year is about to 
begin!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Guy
text_block_list.text:
Nature-chaaaan! Do your best! 
Give it up for the star of the shopping 
arcade!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tahaha, thanks for the cheer.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right! I don't know how long this race 
is, 
but I'm running at full power right from 
the start!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, you do you. 
And I'll do me...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay~! It's Vivlos! My condition is... 
just as you can see♪ 
Cheer for me today too♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If I can't win today, there's no way I can 
defeat that girl... Gentildonna. 
I'll show everyone that I am the true 
"Queen" standing at the pinnacle!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us savor today's one-of-a-kind musica, 
never to be heard again. 
The single note marking my victory after a 
mortal struggle is the most beautiful 
sound in this world!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, wait up! 
We came to join in on the fun too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! 
A showdown just isn't complete without me, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaaah~! Tokai Teio!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Pardon our sudden intrusion! 
We're going to clash with everything we've 
got, so please enjoy the show, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah~! Even Special Week is here!! 
Amazing, this really feels like a 
festival...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's an exhibition race, getting 
to run with Teio-san is amazing! 
Still, I won't lose! For the sake of 
everyone cheering for me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's make this the best race ever! 
We've gotta look super cool for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Carrying all the expectations 
we've received so far on our shoulders, we 
will definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Living up to cheers... and expectations... 
There's a real weight to their words.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's how deeply, passionately loved 
they've been. 
Though I'm sure that doesn't apply only to 
them.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I too... to someone...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... And there are people who might 
start caring from today on, too...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Let's captivate them all 
with this race!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Victory is a given. I accept nothing less 
than complete dominance... 
I will prove to the fans that I am the 
"strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The competing Umamusume are making their 
way into the gates.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the hopes of countless people and 
their own dreams on their backs, 
the exhibition race is now—underway!
